reviewStatus: Reviewed; ready for optimized runtime verification by integration owner
authorship: Original custom vertex-authored anatomy, UV pigment and normal images, skeleton and motion; no external geometry, texture or rig used. Old imported model isolated under archived-external-predecessor and never loaded by original authoring script.
anatomyReviewed: Low streamlined oval shell with five vertebral scutes, four paired costals and 24 thin marginal scutes
Shorter neck blending into broad blunt skull, recessed small eyes with eyelid rim, non-hooked snout
Long narrow flattened front blades with one short claw each; rounded small rear rudders
Cream plastron; olive-brown carapace with independent subdued sunburst patterns
visualFindings: Final four neutral views opened and inspected. Earlier pale pigment, long neck, exposed bead eyes, snout cap UV pinching and sharp folded rear tips were corrected.
All sixteen final pose samples opened together in labeled contact sheet. Shoulder roots remain visually seated and front strokes stay marine; no leg stepping.
Swim has paired shoulder downstroke and restrained distal flex; Float and Glide remain subtle; Turn uses asymmetric fin action, yaw and mild bank.

technicalEvidence.rawTiming: Reexported with export_anim_slide_to_zero=True; original authoring script retains option.
technicalEvidence.textures: Five packed saved UV images; sRGB albedo and Non-Color normal data. Pixel pigment checked to avoid double gamma.

limitations: Authored educational anatomical interpretation, not photogrammetry or a museum scan. Generated scale pigment does not reproduce an individual turtle.
Shell, plastron, soft tissue and eyes are intersecting anatomical surfaces, not one watertight sculpt. Deforming roots use explicit blended weights.
Four views and quarter-cycle samples are visual evidence, not exhaustive continuous collision analysis.
Neutral review background has a visible distant studio floor edge at the bottom in low-angle views; studio helpers are excluded from GLB.
Optimized runtime artifact review belongs to the integration owner; this report covers the stable Blender source and raw export.
